description: Mention rate and share of voice for the brand and each competitor on one engine over a window (default: last 30 days), plus per-prompt coverage. Each metric is {state: "ok", point, lo, hi, n} — a proportion with its 95% interval — or {state: "insufficient_data"} when fewer than ten responses exist, or {state: "undefined"}. A metric with state insufficient_data is NOT zero; do not report it as a number, and do not compare two metrics whose intervals overlap as if one were higher. "asOf" is the day the numbers describe. "historyFrom" is set when the window was clamped to the plan's history. "modelIds" lists the provider models seen; a change there can move metrics on its own. "intents" pools the per-prompt coverage by question type, each with its own n. Report the brand's rate on commercial (buying) questions separately from informational ones, and treat an insufficient_data row as no number. "firstNamed" is how often the entity is the first of the tracked companies an answer names (n = share of voice's): a proxy for being the first pick, not a recommendation. engine defaults to google_aio: call once per engine the brand measures (its engines) and report each separately.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

engine.description: google_aio = Google AI Overviews; google_ai_mode = Google AI Mode; chatgpt = ChatGPT. Defaults to google_aio.
